title: Khao-soi Style Garlic Crusty Thai Chicken Curried Noodle Bake
description: A creamy and garlicky brunch dish inspired by the flavors of Khao-soi from northeastern Thailand, featuring rolled oats and a crispy crust.
instructions: Cook the rolled oats according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the sliced shallots to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes until softened.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, and curry powder. Add the cooked chicken to the bowl and toss to coat.
Add the cooked oats, Thai basil, and chicken broth to the bowl and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with additional Thai basil if desired.
Bake the dish in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes until the top is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
